title: The Most Pathetic Man in Fitness.
summary: Part 22 of his 'Fake Merc Character Study' roast series about YouTuber Jason Blaha, revived after Blaha accused the 'Noble Natties' of steroid use and racism and accused NH of mocking abuse victims. NH rebuts the accusations, repeats many allegations of his own (some he admits are unconfirmed), and frames Blaha as a vulnerable narcissist. Fitness content is minimal: bad curl technique, natty-accusation logic, and Alex Leonidas's strength.
claims: The 'character study' series exists to expose and mock lolcows in the fitness sphere, people who embarrass themselves without realising it
People get accused of steroid use because they look too good to be natural; calling a small, out-of-shape lifter natty-or-not makes no sense
A proper curl moves only the forearm; raising the shoulders and swinging the hips turns it into a compound movement and explains poor biceps more than genetics
Refusing PEDs even when fitness is your income is a matter of having principles
Drama channels attack bigger creators and use their names in titles to milk views because nobody watches their training content
His YouTube termination came from an anti-pornography video pointing out sexual content reachable by minors; the community and Noble Natties helped get the channel back
He gains roughly 3-5k subscribers a month and expects to pass his rival's subscriber count
He threw his 100K YouTube plaque away; attaching self-worth to subscriber numbers is pathetic
Deleting comments on your own videos hurts reach, because comments are free engagement for the algorithm
He reads vulnerable-narcissist traits into the rival: can't take criticism, needs praise, unclear sense of self, manipulation, no empathy, poor relationships, envy, blaming others, weak boundaries
Alex Leonidas is stronger than his rival on every lift at a lighter, natural bodyweight and has benched four plates, beating the rival's bench PR in an official meet
A lifter who has not added a pound to his close-grip bench in four years, despite drugs and high bodyweight, has stopped progressing
If you are kind to people who treat kindness as weakness, they exploit it; don't try to help them
Vulnerable narcissism tends to come from childhood neglect; such people blame family for their failures and seek approval from capable men
He describes reporting a man who tried to sell him fake gems with absurd claims (descendant of Da Vinci, Marine sniper, owner of the Indian railways); the man was arrested
Scars on his neck come from the bar during front squats
exercises: only the forearm moves; no shoulder shrug, no hip swing
keeps tension on the biceps instead of turning it into a body swing
bar rests on the front of the neck
he got neck scars from the bar
